title: Name change on an account
symptom: An employee has changed her name and needs her accounts updated
user_description: One of our staff has changed her surname. Can you update her email and login to the new name?

options.text: Create a new account and delete the old one
options.why: Loses her mailbox, files and history. Renaming keeps everything intact.

options.text: Change it on a phone call from someone who says they are from HR, without checking
options.why: Name changes alter someone's identity in every system, so the request must be confirmed through a trusted channel. A caller claiming to be HR proves nothing.

options.text: Follow the process with HR's confirmation, update the name and sign-in address, and keep the old address as an alias so mail still arrives
options.why: Updating the existing account keeps her data. Keeping the old address as an alias means people who still use it can reach her.

options.text: Change only the display name and leave the email address
options.why: Leaves her with a mismatched identity across systems, which causes confusion and sign-in problems later.

hints: Who has the authority to ask for a name change?
What would you lose if you made a new account?
How will people who use the old address still reach her?
real_world_tip: Warn her she may need to sign in with the new name and re-enter it in some apps.
